title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Google Identity Sync from Google Workspace to Entra ID
summary: The briefing's identity-sync behaviour, admin paths, tenant-size limit and licensing caveats are supported by Microsoft Learn and the roadmap record. The governance checklist names reporting, licence assignment and membership review controls that are missing from its controls table; this is a minor consistency finding.

claims.claim: Google Identity Sync provides one-way identity synchronisation from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365.
claims.quote: Google Identity Sync provides one-way synchronization of user and group identities from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365.
